messages:
Maria (cust-success): Quick postmortem follow-up for Adalyn Dedicated — they hit repeated tenant isolation during VPC peering flaps yesterday. Need owners + concrete timelines for remediations. TL;DR: peering TCP keepalive drops, on-prem firewall behavior + runtime isolation bug triggered cascade.
Ken (eng-sre): Ack. Can you paste the minimal repro logs?
Maria (cust-success): Pasting the short excerpt from the incident timeline: `2026-03-20T21:12:03Z - peer SYN retransmit; 21:12:07Z - keepalive timeout; 21:12:09Z - control-plane mark isolated; 21:12:10Z - fallback to smaller instance group`
Carlos (eng-runtime): I saw similar markers in the runtime traces — the isolation heuristic misinterprets transient TCP resets as persistent failure, causing aggressive teardown. I can reproduce locally with a controlled packet drop.
Laura (eng-platform): Important to separate two workstreams: (1) customer-side/network config guidance for on-prem firewalls; (2) runtime change to make isolation heuristic tolerate short flaps.
Sami (oncall): We also need a Dedicated deployment checklist update so on-call can quickly validate peering health indicators. Right now the dashboard only shows peer status boolean.
Ken (eng-sre): Proposed action items (short):
1) Runbook update for VPC peering hardening + recommended firewall keepalive settings — owner: Ken — ETA: 2026-03-27
2) Runtime fix: change isolation window to be less aggressive and add hysteresis + telemetry flag — owner: Carlos — ETA: 2026-04-03 (patch), 2026-04-10 (canary)
3) Dedicated checklist & dashboard metrics (per-tenant peering rtt, keepalive retransmits) — owner: Laura — ETA: 2026-03-30
4) Customer comms + remediation steps for Adalyn (CS-led) — owner: Maria — ETA: 2026-03-24
5) Post-deploy verification runbook for oncall (sami) and scheduled 2-week follow-up — owner: Sami — ETA: 2026-04-12
Maria (cust-success): Sounds good. Adding note: Adalyn accepts a phased approach — they want immediate docs + temporary guardrails first.
Carlos (eng-runtime): For the runtime fix, here's the quick experiment I ran: `isolation_window_ms=5000` -> prevented false isolation in 3/3 repro runs. I'll open a PR with tests and a feature flag.
Ken (eng-sre): I'll handle the peering doc. Key configs to recommend: `tcp_keepalive_time=60`, `tcp_keepalive_intvl=10`, and ensure stateful firewall allows keepalive probes. Also add SNAT stability note for on-prem appliances.
Laura (eng-platform): I'll add per-route peering metrics to the console and a quick alert template: `alert if keepalive_retransmits > 3 within 10s for a single tenant`.
incidents-bot: Reminder: create a follow-up issue in the incident tracker when owners are assigned.
Maria (cust-success): I've opened INC-7812 in the tracker and linked the customer's case notes. Will post the public remediation steps to the customer by EOD tomorrow.
Carlos (eng-runtime): PR drafted: `runtime#5342` — includes feature flag `runtime.isolation.hysteresis`. Request review from Ken and Laura.
Ken (eng-sre): Reviewing now. Also coordinating with infra to run a targeted peering test window with Adalyn's network team on 2026-03-26.
Sami (oncall): I'll schedule a 30m runbook walk-through for oncall next Tue 2026-03-30 09:00 PT.
Laura (eng-platform): Do we want a short canary on a subset of tenants before global rollout? Carlos: set the flag default off and enable for 5% of Dedicated instances?
Carlos (eng-runtime): Yes; will enable on 5% canary for 24 hours, monitor `isolation_rate` and `fallback_events`.
Maria (cust-success): Owners, please confirm by EOD: Ken, Carlos, Laura, Sami. I'll send the customer status after we confirm the docs and the temporary guidance.
Ken (eng-sre): Confirmed.
Carlos (eng-runtime): Confirmed.
Laura (eng-platform): Confirmed.
Sami (oncall): Confirmed.
Maria (cust-success): Thanks everyone. We'll track progress in INC-7812 and do a 1-week retro on recurring peering issues next Friday. Also noting pattern: similar tenant isolation observed in 2025-11 (different customers) — recommend we add a recurring analysis to triage any pattern across Dedicated deployments.
Ken (eng-sre): Agreed. I'll add a data query to surface historical peering flaps by tenant and submit a follow-up if patterns persist.
incidents-bot: Note: action items recorded: runbook (Ken), runtime PR (Carlos), dashboard (Laura), oncall check (Sami), customer comms (Maria).
